text:
alex: Heads-up: exploring an adjustable split-pane for the Usage & Billing page — left controls (scope, budget caps, token denom toggle) + right content (charts, invoice preview). Feels like a power-user layout.
priya: adjustable divider could be great for power users. One concern: users might hide controls and lose discoverability. Maybe persist a compact mini-rail when collapsed.
tom: mini-rail idea is neat — icons + tooltips. Also add an inline invoice thumbnail (small preview) so users can confirm before download.
yvonne: accessibility: if divider is draggable, ensure keyboard equivalents (arrow keys to nudge, Home/End to collapse/expand) and announce position via aria-live. Also provide skip link to main charts.
alex: good point. Also thinking about a token denomination toggle: raw tokens vs $ cost estimate vs normalized compute units.
priya: expand on budget caps per project — allow pinning caps with a warning ribbon on charts when near limit. Microcopy: "Set budget cap" vs "Set spending cap"? Which reads clearer?
tom: "Set spending cap" maps better to finance. Avoid 'budget' because it's ambiguous.
yvonne: color & patterns: if we show ribbons and caps across projects, use dashed patterns for cap lines and solid fills for usage; ensure 4.5:1 contrast for thin lines—if not possible, increase thickness.
alex: for invoice exports: propose a lightweight preview modal that shows first 3 line items + format chooser (PDF/CSV/Line items). Default to last-chosen format.
priya: analytics: events: billing.ui.splitpane.adjusted, billing.cap.set, billing.invoice.preview_opened, billing.invoice.downloaded with payload {format,org_id,project_id}.
tom: mobile fallback: stacked progressive disclosure — show a compact "Billing controls" chip that opens full controls in a modal. Keep invoice thumbnail as an inline card after charts.
yvonne: keyboard nav: Tabbing order: controls -> charts -> invoice preview -> footer. All interactive elements need aria-label and aria-expanded where applicable.
alex: microcopy tweak: change "Tokens" header to "Compute tokens (estimated cost shown)" and tooltip "Toggle to see USD estimates".
design-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/splitpane789 — includes split-pane desktop, mini-rail collapsed, mobile modal, and invoice preview modal. Notes on keyboard nudging and aria-live strings included.
priya: action items: tom — prototype draggable divider + keyboard nudging; yvonne — write ARIA snippets and contrast tweaks; alex — draft cap microcopy & ribbons; I'll add analytics schema and wire mock. 30m review after clickable is ready.
tom: will push prototype by EOD.
yvonne: posting ARIA snippets in thread and prepping pattern swatches.
priya: thanks team — will send calendar invite and attach Figma link in the invite. :spiral_calendar:
